full_judgment: 2. Facts necessary for disposal of the Rule are that the Opposite Party as plaintiff instituted Title Suit No. 75 of 1995 in the Court of the learned Senior Assistant Judge, Debidwar, Comilla praying for declaration of title in 4 annas share to the suit property appertaining to S.A. Khatian No. 308 of mouza Fultali. P.S. Debidwar, District-Comilla contending inter alia. that the suit jote belonged to Akamat Ali and his other three brothers each having 4 annas share. Akamat Ali died leaving behind one soil Zulfu and two daughter the plaintiff No.1 and Hazra and Zulfu died leaving behind the defendant Nos. 1-7 as heirs. Hazrii died leaving behind the defendant No. 8-10 as heirs. Akram All died leaving behind the defendant Nos. 11 and 12. The S.A. Khatian No. 308 was wrongly prepared without recording the name of the plaintiff and her sister. He came to know about the said record on 28.8.1995 and filed the suit.
